name: MoPNG and Directorate General of Hydrocarbons
description: MoPNG and Directorate General of Hydrocarbons shape upstream licensing, domestic supply, energy security and sector investment. The immediate issue is field development, production commitments, data, fiscal terms and transition policy. Its decisions or actions can alter project economics, approvals and strategic access.
urgency_rationale: Policy and licensing decisions determine capital deployment and production timing.
intel_dossier: 🔎 Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas: MoPNG sets national policy for petroleum, natural gas, refining and related public enterprises. | https://mopng.gov.in/en
🔎 DGH: DGH supports upstream hydrocarbon regulation, data and resource management. | https://www.dghindia.gov.in/
🔎 PNGRB: PNGRB regulates pipelines, city gas distribution, tariffs, access and technical standards. | https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/
alternate_rationale: Keep Satisfied fits stable producing assets; new acreage and policy transition need close engagement.

engagement_tactics.label: Align investment, resilience and transition milestones with MoPNG and Directorate General of Hydrocarbons
engagement_tactics.rationale: Connects business commitments to public-policy outcomes and makes delivery auditable.

engagement_tactics.label: Seek an informal exemption through political contacts
engagement_tactics.rationale: Creates governance and reputational exposure without solving the underlying issue.

engagement_tactics.label: Announce investment before land, technology and economics are validated
engagement_tactics.rationale: Overpromising weakens credibility and can trigger public backlash.

name: PNGRB
description: PNGRB regulates pipelines, city gas networks, tariffs, access and safety standards. The immediate issue is authorisation milestones, common-carrier access, tariffs, integrity and customer service. Its decisions or actions can delay projects, modify economics or impose safety action.
urgency_rationale: Authorisation and network decisions have hard construction and commercial deadlines.
intel_dossier: 🔎 PNGRB: PNGRB regulates pipelines, city gas distribution, tariffs, access and technical standards. | https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/
🔎 PNGRB regulations: PNGRB publishes notified regulations for pipelines, CGD and safety. | https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/regulation.html
🔎 OISD: OISD formulates and coordinates oil-and-gas safety standards and audits. | https://www.oisd.gov.in/en-in
alternate_rationale: Keep Satisfied is plausible for mature compliant networks, but expansion and tariff proceedings require close management.

engagement_tactics.label: Create a single evidence room and joint workplan with PNGRB
engagement_tactics.rationale: Gives the authority traceable data, named owners and early visibility of corrective action.

engagement_tactics.label: Rely mainly on trade-association lobbying
engagement_tactics.rationale: Collective advocacy cannot substitute for company-specific compliance evidence.

engagement_tactics.label: Wait for a notice, inspection or deficiency letter
engagement_tactics.rationale: Reactive engagement reduces room to correct problems before enforcement.

name: Landowners, Fishing Communities and Local Residents
description: Landowners, Fishing Communities and Local Residents bear land, livelihood, safety, pollution and traffic impacts from assets and pipelines. The immediate issue is fair compensation, livelihood restoration, spill risk and grievance closure. Its decisions or actions can block access, litigate, protest or withdraw cooperation.
urgency_rationale: Local consent and access can become the project’s critical path.
intel_dossier: 🔎 MoEFCC: MoEFCC administers environmental clearance and pollution-control frameworks. | https://moef.gov.in/
🔎 National Green Tribunal: NGT can adjudicate environmental harm and compliance disputes. | https://greentribunal.gov.in/
🔎 PNGRB: PNGRB regulates pipelines, city gas distribution, tariffs, access and technical standards. | https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/
alternate_rationale: Keep Informed may fit low-impact operating assets with strong trust; new corridors require close partnership.

engagement_tactics.label: Create a representative forum with independent data review for Landowners, Fishing Communities and Local Residents
engagement_tactics.rationale: Combines voice, verifiable evidence and a public commitments tracker.

engagement_tactics.label: Replace consultation with local donations
engagement_tactics.rationale: Philanthropy does not address rights, exposure or operational impacts.

engagement_tactics.label: Engage only through local political intermediaries
engagement_tactics.rationale: Excludes affected groups and makes consent appear managed rather than earned.

name: Employees, Contract Workers and Unions
description: Employees, Contract Workers and Unions operate complex assets, turnarounds and emergency systems. The immediate issue is process safety, contractor competence, fatigue, skills and transition. Its decisions or actions can prevent or cause major incidents and prolonged shutdowns.
urgency_rationale: Front-line decisions are time-critical in hydrocarbon operations.
intel_dossier: 🔎 OISD: OISD formulates and coordinates oil-and-gas safety standards and audits. | https://www.oisd.gov.in/en-in
🔎 PESO: PESO regulates hazardous petroleum storage, transport and equipment safety. | https://peso.gov.in/web/en/home
🔎 PNGRB regulations: PNGRB publishes notified regulations for pipelines, CGD and safety. | https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/regulation.html
alternate_rationale: Keep Informed is suitable for lower-risk support teams; operating crews need close management.

engagement_tactics.label: Negotiate a safety, skills and workload plan with Employees, Contract Workers and Unions
engagement_tactics.rationale: Uses formal worker voice and measurable actions to reduce operational and labour risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Use attendance bonuses to suppress grievances
engagement_tactics.rationale: Treats symptoms, discourages reporting and can worsen fatigue-related risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Communicate only through line supervisors
engagement_tactics.rationale: Workers need trusted escalation channels and protection from retaliation.

name: Refineries, Power Producers, CGD Companies and Industrial Buyers
description: Refineries, Power Producers, CGD Companies and Industrial Buyers anchor demand through long-term contracts, nominations and quality requirements. The immediate issue is volume reliability, pricing, gas quality, flexibility and force majeure. Its decisions or actions can reshape asset utilisation and cash flow.
urgency_rationale: Offtake and nomination decisions directly affect daily operations and project finance.
intel_dossier: 🔎 PNGRB: PNGRB regulates pipelines, city gas distribution, tariffs, access and technical standards. | https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/
🔎 Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas: MoPNG sets national policy for petroleum, natural gas, refining and related public enterprises. | https://mopng.gov.in/en
🔎 PNGRB regulations: PNGRB publishes notified regulations for pipelines, CGD and safety. | https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/regulation.html
alternate_rationale: Keep Satisfied may fit diversified spot sales; anchor contracts require close coordination.

engagement_tactics.label: Build a joint service, quality and continuity plan with Refineries, Power Producers, CGD Companies and Industrial Buyers
engagement_tactics.rationale: Makes performance expectations explicit and creates early-warning triggers.

engagement_tactics.label: Promise priority supply to every major account
engagement_tactics.rationale: Conflicting commitments become impossible to honour during a disruption.

engagement_tactics.label: Limit contact to sales teams
engagement_tactics.rationale: Commercial dialogue alone misses quality, safety and operational dependencies.

name: Banks, Bondholders and Institutional Investors
description: Banks, Bondholders and Institutional Investors price commodity, policy, safety, reserve and transition risk. The immediate issue is capital discipline, decommissioning, methane, stranded assets and covenants. Its decisions or actions can raise funding costs or demand portfolio change.
urgency_rationale: Long-cycle projects depend on confidence in execution and policy durability.
intel_dossier: 🔎 Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas: MoPNG sets national policy for petroleum, natural gas, refining and related public enterprises. | https://mopng.gov.in/en
🔎 DGH: DGH supports upstream hydrocarbon regulation, data and resource management. | https://www.dghindia.gov.in/
🔎 MoEFCC: MoEFCC administers environmental clearance and pollution-control frameworks. | https://moef.gov.in/
alternate_rationale: Manage Closely applies during project finance, major incidents, reserve revisions or transition decisions.

engagement_tactics.label: Brief Banks, Bondholders and Institutional Investors on material risks, capital needs, milestones and downside cases
engagement_tactics.rationale: Allows investors to test execution quality rather than rely on broad commitments.

engagement_tactics.label: Describe the exposure as immaterial until a charge is booked
engagement_tactics.rationale: Delayed disclosure increases surprise and credibility risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Promise a fixed outcome that management cannot control
engagement_tactics.rationale: Overconfidence creates litigation and trust risk if regulation or markets change.

name: EPC Firms, Drilling Contractors and Equipment Suppliers
description: EPC Firms, Drilling Contractors and Equipment Suppliers deliver construction, drilling, maintenance and safety-critical equipment. The immediate issue is competence, schedule, quality, localisation and interface management. Its decisions or actions can cause delay, cost overrun or integrity failure.
urgency_rationale: Contractor performance drives both project schedule and major-accident risk.
intel_dossier: 🔎 OISD: OISD formulates and coordinates oil-and-gas safety standards and audits. | https://www.oisd.gov.in/en-in
🔎 PESO: PESO regulates hazardous petroleum storage, transport and equipment safety. | https://peso.gov.in/web/en/home
🔎 DGH: DGH supports upstream hydrocarbon regulation, data and resource management. | https://www.dghindia.gov.in/
alternate_rationale: Keep Informed fits non-critical services; safety-critical work needs integrated control.

engagement_tactics.label: Segment critical suppliers and fund traceability plus remediation with EPC Firms, Drilling Contractors and Equipment Suppliers
engagement_tactics.rationale: Protects continuity while addressing root causes rather than shifting them down-tier.

engagement_tactics.label: Terminate every non-conforming supplier immediately
engagement_tactics.rationale: Abrupt exits can deepen shortages and hide problems in less visible tiers.

engagement_tactics.label: Accept annual self-certification as sufficient
engagement_tactics.rationale: High-risk supply chains require evidence, audit and corrective-action closure.
